question: In a certain code language, 'AFPQV' is written as 'CITVB' and 'DLNPG' is written as 'FORUM'. How will 'LNAGK' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'AFPQV' is written as 'CITVB',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a437be78880a438b31d397fc81dda42848fb70c20250a8ea492d8b6b15de5e.png] 

‘DLNPG' is written as 'FORUM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bc177bd9c38d091c0501049f3a30c63bcf8861d505f29fe3d88978d9e792871.png] 

Similarly, for 'LNAGK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/918ee409ae51aed323a92139513c9ca171890a9f502e623c878f684fedcfb078.png] 

So, 'LNAGK' will be written as 'NQELQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
